quarterly_data.signal: In line with growth of the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) market, the company has localised TSV photoresist and is supplying it to domestic semiconductor companies

The company has completed development of a special polymer glass-coating agent for glass semiconductor substrates and a photoresist for the copper-plating process; it expects glass substrates to make packages thinner and improve chip performance

H1 2026 utilisation by product group: photo materials 67.1%, wet chemical 80.7%, PR rinse 47.4%, other 58.8%; the company keeps spare capacity for customers' mass-production qualification of new products. Products are delivered on order, so there is no order backlog
